_description: Configuration specifically designed for Surat, Gujarat, India - A high-density urban city with mixed traffic patterns

_city_characteristics.economic_activity: Diamond cutting, textile manufacturing, industrial hub
_city_characteristics.traffic_density: Very high - rapid urbanization and economic growth
_city_characteristics.infrastructure_level: Developing - improving with smart city initiatives

_phase_note: Standard 4-way intersection. May need additional phases for complex intersections in industrial areas
_timing_note: Longer green times needed for mixed traffic clearance, especially during peak hours in industrial zones
_yellow_note: Longer yellow time for safety with mixed vehicle types and aggressive driving patterns
_all_red_note: Longer clearance time for safety with mixed traffic, poor lane discipline, and high pedestrian activity
_arrival_rates_note: High arrival rates typical of dense urban areas. Adjust based on specific intersection: higher in industrial areas (Hazira), textile markets, and diamond district
_queue_capacity_note: Higher capacity needed due to: 1) Small vehicles (motorcycles 30-40%, auto-rickshaws 15-20%), 2) Poor lane discipline, 3) High traffic density in commercial areas
_reward_note: Higher queue and wait penalties due to severe congestion impact in mixed traffic scenarios. Efficiency reward encourages smooth flow despite chaotic patterns

_vision_config._confidence_note: Lower threshold to detect small vehicles (motorcycles, auto-rickshaws, bicycles) and handle overlapping/irregular positioning
_vision_config._detection_note: Must detect diverse vehicle types including 2-wheelers (30-40% of traffic), 3-wheelers (15-20%), and handle irregular positioning due to poor lane discipline

vehicle_mix.pedestrians: High volume, especially near markets and industrial areas

_regional_adaptations.lane_discipline: Poor - vehicles don't stay in lanes, frequent lane changes, aggressive driving
_regional_adaptations.detection_challenge: Overlapping vehicles, irregular positioning, vehicles in wrong lanes, high density
_regional_adaptations.traffic_behavior: Aggressive, unpredictable patterns, especially during peak hours (7-10 AM, 5-8 PM)

peak_hours.special_events: Festivals, diamond exhibitions, textile trade shows cause sudden traffic spikes

infrastructure.power: Generally stable but occasional outages - edge computing recommended
infrastructure.network: Improving with smart city initiatives - 4G/5G available
infrastructure.cctv: Existing CCTV infrastructure can be leveraged
infrastructure.deployment: Edge computing preferred for reliability, with cloud backup

special_considerations.industrial_areas: Hazira Industrial Area has heavy truck traffic - may need separate configuration
special_considerations.commercial_zones: Textile markets and diamond district have high pedestrian and vehicle density
special_considerations.festivals: Gujarati festivals (Navratri, Diwali) cause significant traffic pattern changes
special_considerations.monsoon: Heavy rains (June-September) affect traffic flow and visibility

_recommended_technology_stack._control_rationale: Best performance (8.51s wait time), interpretable, robust to uncertainty, no training data needed, handles chaotic traffic patterns
_recommended_technology_stack.vision: YOLOv8-small with custom training for Indian vehicles
_recommended_technology_stack._vision_rationale: Lightweight model suitable for edge deployment, can be fine-tuned on local traffic footage
_recommended_technology_stack.forecasting: Optional - LSTM only if coordinating 5+ intersections and have 6+ months of data
_recommended_technology_stack._forecasting_note: Traffic patterns less predictable due to festivals and events. Skip for single intersections.
_recommended_technology_stack._deployment_rationale: Reliable operation during power/network issues, lower latency, cost-effective for Indian market
_recommended_technology_stack.cost_estimate: $15K-$25K per intersection (edge deployment, YOLOv8-small, Fuzzy Logic)

phase_1.focus: Validate vision detection, tune fuzzy logic parameters, measure baseline performance

phase_2.focus: Multi-intersection coordination, optimize for Surat-specific patterns, integrate with smart city infrastructure

phase_3.focus: Full integration with Surat Smart City systems, advanced analytics, public transport priority

_tuning_parameters.initial_deployment: Use these parameters as starting point
adjustments_needed: Measure actual arrival rates per lane and adjust
Observe queue lengths and adjust queue_capacity
Fine-tune confidence_threshold based on detection accuracy
Adjust reward_weights based on local priorities (congestion vs wait time)
Tune min_green/max_green based on safety observations

seasonal_adjustments.monsoon: Increase cycle_all_red, lower confidence_threshold for reduced visibility
seasonal_adjustments.festival_season: Increase queue_capacity, adjust arrival_rates for peak events

_additional_features.pedestrian_phases: High pedestrian volume near markets and industrial areas - dedicated phases needed
_additional_features.bicycle_integration: Bicycle lanes present in some areas - detection and priority signals
_additional_features.public_transport: BRTS (Bus Rapid Transit System) integration for priority signals
_additional_features.emergency_vehicles: GPS-based preemption systems for ambulances and fire trucks
_additional_features.coordination: Multi-intersection coordination essential for arterial roads
_additional_features.smart_city_integration: Integration with Surat Smart City Command and Control Center

_references.traffic_study: Conduct local traffic study to validate arrival rates and queue capacities
_references.camera_positioning: Leverage existing CCTV infrastructure where possible
_references.stakeholder_engagement: Coordinate with Surat Municipal Corporation and Smart City SPV
_references.compliance: Ensure compliance with Indian traffic regulations and IRC (Indian Roads Congress) standards
